name: Bright Scholarship

extractionHints.detail: Each scholarship post states degree level/coverage/eligible nationality/deadline in a summary table plus prose, and usually links an 'Official Link' — that link is the officialSourceUrl candidate for verification, always worth fetching directly rather than trusting this source's own restatement of the facts.
extractionHints.hostInstitution: Many posts name a specific university in the title (e.g. 'University of Potsdam Scholarships'). That is an explicit host-institution claim and should populate hostInstitutions with the verbatim quote naming it.

notes: DISCOVERY authority only — nothing from here is verified without an independent PRIMARY/SECONDARY corroboration (see lib/verification/crossReferenceCheck.ts). Seed post (Belgium Government ARES Scholarship 2027-28) confirmed real and reachable (2026-08-10); its stated 'Official Link' (ares-ac.be) was independently fetched and corroborates the deadline exactly (18 September 2026) with a largely-overlapping but not identical eligible-country list — a genuine real-world example of partial corroboration, handled by lib/verification/flagConflicts.ts rather than silently merged. 2026-09-05: switched from single-seed to full sitemap discovery — the three post sitemaps enumerate 2,023 posts (1000/1000/23). Pointed at the post sitemaps directly rather than sitemap_index.xml so the tag/category/page sitemaps are never walked. The single-path-segment sitemapUrlPattern additionally excludes /tag/x/ and /category/x/ style URLs. Full crawl is ~2.2 hours at 4s/page.
